```{.quiz-yaml}
id: 02_frequency_bin_width
title: >-
  Choosing a bin width
questions:
  - id: sensible_bin_width
    type: multiple-choice
    prompt: >-
      A researcher records 60 reaction times ranging from 210 to 790
      milliseconds. If we want a compact grouped table that still shows the
      shape of the distribution, which bin width is the most sensible starting
      choice?
    hint: >-
      The reaction times cover about 580 milliseconds. Think about roughly how
      many bins each width would create.
    options:
      - text: >-
          1 millisecond
      - text: >-
          50 milliseconds
        correct: true
      - text: >-
          300 milliseconds
      - text: >-
          600 milliseconds
    explanation: >-
      A width of 50 milliseconds gives us about twelve bins: compact enough to
      summarize the data, but enough to show their shape. A width of 1 would
      create hundreds of bins, while 300 or 600 would leave only one or two.
      No single width is mathematically required, but 50 is the most useful of
      these choices.
```
